drugs.name: low carbohydrate, high protein calorie-restricted diet, exercise, and intensive dietitian counseling
balanced calorie-restricted diet, exercise, and standard counseling

primary_endpoint: Change in fat attenuation parameter (FAP) from baseline to week 12, analyzed in the per-protocol set.
efficacy_outcome: Compared with control, intensive lifestyle intervention significantly reduced FAP (LS mean difference, 16.07 dB/m; 95% CI, 8.90–23.25) and BMI (1.46 kg/m²; 95% CI, 1.09–1.82); LSM improvement was not significant (0.20 kPa; 95% CI, −0.19 to 0.59).
